text:
Type: dark grey plant pot with saucer
Use: growing a houseplant or herbs on a windowsill, shelf or floor; living room, kitchen, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: matte molded plastic, matching saucer
Colors: dark grey, charcoal
Shape: tapered cylindrical pot with a rolled flared rim, sits in a wide shallow saucer, simple and sturdy, compact
Feel: understated, practical, calm, grounded
Goes with: green plants, concrete, light wood, white walls; minimalist, industrial or modern rooms

product.name: JUJUBR
product.description: Ideal for orchids, as the inner ledge keeps the plant away from excess water at the bottom of the pot.
